items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Yeah, I went with Freddie Coleman. ... Fred had made a lot of records. Yeah, we did record.

ctx.x: What was your main job then after that? You said that Freddie Coleman, you went with him.
Yeah, I went with Freddie Coleman.
The bunch was in the picture, mostly. Yeah. So you all was there. Tourmalon played with him for a while, didn't he?

items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: That was the same band as Freddie Coleman. Yeah. Where were they? We were working at the, uh, Sidney Villa place.

ctx.x: Well, who did you make records with?

Records? Yeah. Did I make any records? Okay. Yeah, I did, uh, Kit Harvin. Uh, yeah. Nope. I didn't do too much recording. It's Freddie Coleman. Yeah, you made it. Yeah, I read some. Remember I already showed you that book? Yeah, Freddie Coleman, I did something with some people, I forgot, beat two, three times.
